test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of interest (R) = 9% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (2500 × 9 × 6) / 100

SI = 135000 / 100

⇒ SI = 1350

**The simple interest on ₹2500 at 9% per year for 6 years is ₹1350.**
